The person behind Travel With Sarah

Big adventures.
A personal beginning.

I’m Sarah Harry, an Iowa-based independent travel consultant through Archer Travel. I’m glad your next adventure brought you here.

Let’s Talk About Your Trip↗
Hello from Iowa

A new chapter,
a familiar love of people.

After two decades in customer service, I took the leap to become a travel agent. I’m excited to help you begin planning journeys and explore the places you’ve been dreaming about.

My husband has supported this change, and my daughter is right there cheering me on. We also share our home with four Pomsky dogs, who bring plenty of adventures of their own.

Travel With Sarah is my public-facing travel brand. I work independently through Archer Travel.

What matters to me

Enjoy the adventures.
Share the memories.

My outlook is simple: enjoy the small and big adventures with the people you love.

Whether your idea is a family trip, a cruise, or time to discover somewhere new, tell me what matters most to you. A conversation is a good first step.

Sarah

Have a question about how I work? Ask me directly about current services, fees, and booking arrangements.
